questions.question: List all genres
questions.sql: SELECT "GenreId", "Name" FROM "Genre" ORDER BY "Name" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: How many customers do we have?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM "Customer" LIMIT 501

questions.question: Show all employees and their job titles
questions.sql: SELECT "FirstName" || ' ' || "LastName" AS "FullName", "Title" AS "JobTitle" FROM "Employee" ORDER BY "LastName" ASC, "FirstName" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: List customers from Brazil
questions.sql: SELECT "c"."CustomerId", CONCAT("c"."FirstName", ' ', "c"."LastName") AS "customer", "c"."City", "c"."State", "c"."Country" FROM "Customer" AS "c" WHERE "c"."Country" = 'Brazil' ORDER BY customer ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Which media types are available?
questions.sql: SELECT "MediaType"."Name" FROM "MediaType" ORDER BY "MediaType"."Name" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Show tracks longer than 10 minutes
questions.sql: SELECT "t"."Name" AS "track", "t"."Milliseconds" / 60000.0 AS "duration_minutes" FROM "Track" AS "t" WHERE "t"."Milliseconds" > 600000 ORDER BY duration_minutes DESC, track ASC LIMIT 100

questions.question: List business customers (those with a company)
questions.sql: SELECT "c"."CustomerId", CONCAT("c"."FirstName", ' ', "c"."LastName") AS "customer", "c"."Company" FROM "Customer" AS "c" WHERE "c"."Company" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "c"."Company" ASC, customer ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Which tracks have no composer listed?
questions.sql: SELECT "TrackId", "Name" FROM "Track" WHERE "Composer" IS NULL ORDER BY "Name" ASC, "TrackId" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Show invoices above 20 dollars
questions.sql: SELECT "Invoice"."InvoiceId", "Invoice"."CustomerId", "Invoice"."InvoiceDate", "Invoice"."BillingCountry", "Invoice"."Total" FROM "Invoice" WHERE "Invoice"."Total" > 20 ORDER BY "Invoice"."Total" DESC, "Invoice"."InvoiceId" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: List the video tracks priced at 1.99
questions.sql: SELECT "Track"."Name", "Track"."UnitPrice" FROM "Track" INNER JOIN "MediaType" ON "Track"."MediaTypeId" = "MediaType"."MediaTypeId" WHERE "MediaType"."Name" ILIKE '%video%' AND "Track"."UnitPrice" = 1.99 ORDER BY "Track"."Name" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: How many playlists exist?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "playlist_count" FROM "Playlist" LIMIT 501

questions.question: Customers in Canada or the USA
questions.sql: SELECT "c"."CustomerId", CONCAT("c"."FirstName", ' ', "c"."LastName") AS "customer", "c"."Country" FROM "Customer" AS "c" WHERE "c"."Country" IN ('Canada', 'USA') ORDER BY "c"."Country" ASC, customer ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: How many tracks are in the catalog?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "track_count" FROM "Track" LIMIT 501

questions.question: How many artists do we carry?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "artist_count" FROM "Artist" LIMIT 501

questions.question: List the customers who live in Paris
questions.sql: SELECT "c"."CustomerId", CONCAT("c"."FirstName", ' ', "c"."LastName") AS "customer" FROM "Customer" AS "c" WHERE "c"."City" = 'Paris' ORDER BY customer ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: How many customers have no state recorded?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "customers_without_state" FROM "Customer" AS "c" WHERE "c"."State" IS NULL OR TRIM("c"."State") = '' LIMIT 501

questions.question: Show tracks shorter than one minute
questions.sql: SELECT "Track"."Name", "Track"."Milliseconds" / 60000.0 AS "DurationMinutes" FROM "Track" WHERE "Track"."Milliseconds" < 60000 ORDER BY "Track"."Name" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Which albums have the word "Greatest" in the title?
questions.sql: SELECT "Album"."Title" FROM "Album" WHERE "Album"."Title" ILIKE '%Greatest%' ORDER BY "Album"."Title" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Invoices billed to London
questions.sql: SELECT "Invoice"."InvoiceId", "Invoice"."InvoiceDate", "Invoice"."BillingCity", "Invoice"."BillingCountry", "Invoice"."Total" FROM "Invoice" WHERE "Invoice"."BillingCity" ILIKE 'London' ORDER BY "Invoice"."InvoiceDate" ASC, "Invoice"."InvoiceId" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: How many invoices are for exactly 0.99?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT("Invoice"."InvoiceId") AS "invoice_count" FROM "Invoice" WHERE "Invoice"."Total" = 0.99 LIMIT 501

questions.question: Tracks whose name starts with "Love"
questions.sql: SELECT "Track"."Name" FROM "Track" WHERE "Track"."Name" ILIKE 'Love%' ORDER BY "Track"."Name" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Tracks larger than 500 megabytes
questions.sql: SELECT "Track"."Name", "Track"."Bytes" FROM "Track" WHERE "Track"."Bytes" > 500 * 1024 * 1024 ORDER BY "Track"."Name" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Which employees have an IT job title?
questions.sql: SELECT "Employee"."FirstName" || ' ' || "Employee"."LastName" AS "FullName", "Employee"."Title" FROM "Employee" WHERE "Employee"."Title" ILIKE 'IT%' ORDER BY "Employee"."LastName" ASC, "Employee"."FirstName" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: What is the total playing time of the whole catalog, in hours?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM("Milliseconds") / 3600000.0 AS "total_hours" FROM "Track" LIMIT 501

questions.question: Total revenue per year
questions.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate") AS "period_year", SUM("Invoice"."Total") AS "revenue" FROM "Invoice" GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate") ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate") ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: How many customers per country?
questions.sql: SELECT "c"."Country" AS "country", COUNT(DISTINCT "c"."CustomerId") AS "customers" FROM "Customer" AS "c" GROUP BY "c"."Country" ORDER BY customers DESC, country ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: What is the average invoice value?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG("Invoice"."Total") AS "average_invoice_value" FROM "Invoice" LIMIT 501

questions.question: Number of tracks per media type
questions.sql: SELECT "mt"."Name" AS "media_type", COUNT("t"."TrackId") AS "tracks" FROM "MediaType" AS "mt" LEFT JOIN "Track" AS "t" ON "t"."MediaTypeId" = "mt"."MediaTypeId" GROUP BY "mt"."MediaTypeId", "mt"."Name" ORDER BY tracks DESC, "mt"."Name" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Revenue by billing country
questions.sql: SELECT "Invoice"."BillingCountry", SUM("Invoice"."Total") AS "revenue" FROM "Invoice" GROUP BY "Invoice"."BillingCountry" ORDER BY "revenue" DESC LIMIT 501

questions.question: How many employees hold each job title?
questions.sql: SELECT "Title", COUNT(*) AS "employee_count" FROM "Employee" GROUP BY "Title" ORDER BY "Title" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Monthly revenue in 2024
questions.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate") AS "period_year", EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate") AS "period_month", SUM("Invoice"."Total") AS "revenue" FROM "Invoice" WHERE "Invoice"."InvoiceDate" >= '2024-01-01' AND "Invoice"."InvoiceDate" < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate"), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate") ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate") ASC, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate") ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Which countries have more than 5 customers?
questions.sql: SELECT "c"."Country", COUNT("c"."CustomerId") AS "customer_count" FROM "Customer" AS "c" GROUP BY "c"."Country" HAVING COUNT("c"."CustomerId") > 5 ORDER BY "c"."Country" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Average track length in minutes per genre
questions.sql: SELECT "g"."Name" AS "genre", AVG("t"."Milliseconds") / 60000.0 AS "average_track_length_minutes" FROM "Track" AS "t" INNER JOIN "Genre" AS "g" ON "g"."GenreId" = "t"."GenreId" GROUP BY "g"."GenreId", "g"."Name" ORDER BY "g"."Name" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: How many distinct customers bought something each year?
questions.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "i"."InvoiceDate") AS "year", COUNT(DISTINCT "i"."CustomerId") AS "distinct_customers" FROM "Invoice" AS "i" GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "i"."InvoiceDate") ORDER BY year ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: What is the largest invoice ever issued?
questions.sql: SELECT "InvoiceId", "InvoiceDate", "Total" FROM "Invoice" ORDER BY "Total" DESC, "InvoiceDate" ASC, "InvoiceId" ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Total units sold and revenue per quarter of 2023
questions.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate") AS "period_year", EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate") AS "period_quarter", SUM("Invoice"."Total") AS "revenue" FROM "Invoice" WHERE "Invoice"."InvoiceDate" >= '2023-01-01' AND "Invoice"."InvoiceDate" < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate"), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate") ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate") ASC, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate") ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: What is our total revenue to date?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM("Invoice"."Total") AS "revenue" FROM "Invoice" LIMIT 501

questions.question: How many invoices did we issue in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT("Invoice"."InvoiceId") AS "invoice_count" FROM "Invoice" WHERE "Invoice"."InvoiceDate" >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND "Invoice"."InvoiceDate" < DATE '2024-01-01' LIMIT 501

questions.question: Number of albums per artist, most prolific first
questions.sql: SELECT "ar"."ArtistId", "ar"."Name" AS "artist", COUNT("al"."AlbumId") AS "album_count" FROM "Artist" AS "ar" LEFT JOIN "Album" AS "al" ON "al"."ArtistId" = "ar"."ArtistId" GROUP BY "ar"."ArtistId", "ar"."Name" ORDER BY album_count DESC, artist ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: How many tracks cost 0.99 and how many cost 1.99?
questions.sql: SELECT "UnitPrice", COUNT(*) AS "TrackCount" FROM "Track" WHERE "UnitPrice" IN (0.99, 1.99) GROUP BY "UnitPrice" ORDER BY "UnitPrice" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Average invoice value per billing country
questions.sql: SELECT "Invoice"."BillingCountry", AVG("Invoice"."Total") AS "average_invoice_value" FROM "Invoice" GROUP BY "Invoice"."BillingCountry" ORDER BY "average_invoice_value" DESC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Which cities have more than one customer?
questions.sql: SELECT "City", COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM "Customer" GROUP BY "City" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY "City" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: How many units have we sold in total?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM("Quantity") AS "total_units_sold" FROM "InvoiceLine" LIMIT 501

questions.question: Revenue by year and quarter
questions.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "InvoiceDate") AS "year", EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM "InvoiceDate") AS "quarter", SUM("Total") AS "revenue" FROM "Invoice" GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "InvoiceDate"), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM "InvoiceDate") ORDER BY year ASC, quarter ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: What is the smallest invoice total?
questions.sql: SELECT MIN("Invoice"."Total") AS "smallest_invoice_total" FROM "Invoice" LIMIT 501

questions.question: What share of our revenue comes from the USA?
questions.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "Invoice"."BillingCountry" = 'USA' THEN "Invoice"."Total" ELSE 0 END) / SUM("Invoice"."Total") AS "usa_revenue_share_percent" FROM "Invoice" LIMIT 501

questions.question: Average number of tracks per invoice
questions.sql: SELECT "rosie_num"."v" * 1.0 / NULLIF("rosie_den"."v", 0) AS "units_per_invoice" FROM (SELECT COUNT("Invoice"."InvoiceId") AS "v" FROM "Invoice") AS "rosie_den" CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM("InvoiceLine"."Quantity") AS "v" FROM "InvoiceLine") AS "rosie_num" LIMIT 501

questions.question: How many countries did we bill in 2025?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Invoice"."BillingCountry") AS "country_count" FROM "Invoice" WHERE "Invoice"."InvoiceDate" >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND "Invoice"."InvoiceDate" < DATE '2026-01-01' LIMIT 501

questions.question: List albums with their artist name
questions.sql: SELECT "Album"."Title" AS "Album", "Artist"."Name" AS "Artist" FROM "Album" INNER JOIN "Artist" ON "Album"."ArtistId" = "Artist"."ArtistId" ORDER BY "Album"."Title" ASC, "Artist"."Name" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Revenue by genre
questions.sql: SELECT "Genre"."Name", SUM("InvoiceLine"."UnitPrice" * "InvoiceLine"."Quantity") AS "line_revenue" FROM "InvoiceLine" LEFT JOIN "Track" ON "Track"."TrackId" = "InvoiceLine"."TrackId" LEFT JOIN "Genre" ON "Genre"."GenreId" = "Track"."GenreId" GROUP BY "Genre"."Name" ORDER BY "line_revenue" DESC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Sales by support agent
questions.sql: SELECT "e"."EmployeeId", CONCAT("e"."FirstName", ' ', "e"."LastName") AS "agent", COUNT("i"."InvoiceId") AS "invoices", SUM("i"."Total") AS "revenue" FROM "Employee" AS "e" INNER JOIN "Customer" AS "c" ON "c"."SupportRepId" = "e"."EmployeeId" INNER JOIN "Invoice" AS "i" ON "i"."CustomerId" = "c"."CustomerId" GROUP BY "e"."EmployeeId", "e"."FirstName", "e"."LastName" ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 501

questions.question: How many tracks does each album by Led Zeppelin have?
questions.sql: SELECT "Album"."Title" AS "Album", COUNT("Track"."TrackId") AS "TrackCount" FROM "Artist" INNER JOIN "Album" ON "Album"."ArtistId" = "Artist"."ArtistId" LEFT JOIN "Track" ON "Track"."AlbumId" = "Album"."AlbumId" WHERE "Artist"."Name" = 'Led Zeppelin' GROUP BY "Album"."AlbumId", "Album"."Title" ORDER BY "Album"."Title" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Which customers does Jane Peacock support?
questions.sql: SELECT "c"."CustomerId", CONCAT("c"."FirstName", ' ', "c"."LastName") AS "customer" FROM "Customer" AS "c" INNER JOIN "Employee" AS "e" ON "c"."SupportRepId" = "e"."EmployeeId" WHERE "e"."FirstName" = 'Jane' AND "e"."LastName" = 'Peacock' ORDER BY customer ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Tracks that were never sold
questions.sql: SELECT "t"."TrackId", "t"."Name" FROM "Track" AS "t" LEFT JOIN "InvoiceLine" AS "il" ON "il"."TrackId" = "t"."TrackId" WHERE "il"."InvoiceLineId" IS NULL ORDER BY "t"."Name" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Artists that have no albums
questions.sql: SELECT "ar"."ArtistId", "ar"."Name" AS "artist" FROM "Artist" AS "ar" LEFT JOIN "Album" AS "al" ON "al"."ArtistId" = "ar"."ArtistId" WHERE "al"."AlbumId" IS NULL ORDER BY artist ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Number of tracks on each playlist
questions.sql: SELECT "p"."PlaylistId", "p"."Name" AS "playlist", COUNT("pt"."TrackId") AS "tracks" FROM "Playlist" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "PlaylistTrack" AS "pt" ON "pt"."PlaylistId" = "p"."PlaylistId" GROUP BY "p"."PlaylistId", "p"."Name" ORDER BY tracks DESC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Who reports to whom?
questions.sql: SELECT CONCAT("e"."FirstName", ' ', "e"."LastName") AS "employee", "e"."Title", CONCAT("m"."FirstName", ' ', "m"."LastName") AS "manager" FROM "Employee" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "Employee" AS "m" ON "m"."EmployeeId" = "e"."ReportsTo" ORDER BY manager ASC, employee ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Revenue per media type
questions.sql: SELECT "MediaType"."Name", SUM("InvoiceLine"."UnitPrice" * "InvoiceLine"."Quantity") AS "line_revenue" FROM "InvoiceLine" LEFT JOIN "Track" ON "Track"."TrackId" = "InvoiceLine"."TrackId" LEFT JOIN "MediaType" ON "MediaType"."MediaTypeId" = "Track"."MediaTypeId" GROUP BY "MediaType"."Name" ORDER BY "line_revenue" DESC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Which genres has the customer Luis Goncalves bought?
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT "Genre"."Name" AS "Genre" FROM "Customer" INNER JOIN "Invoice" ON "Invoice"."CustomerId" = "Customer"."CustomerId" INNER JOIN "InvoiceLine" ON "InvoiceLine"."InvoiceId" = "Invoice"."InvoiceId" INNER JOIN "Track" ON "Track"."TrackId" = "InvoiceLine"."TrackId" INNER JOIN "Genre" ON "Genre"."GenreId" = "Track"."GenreId" WHERE "Customer"."LastName" = 'Gonçalves' ORDER BY "Genre"."Name" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: For each sales agent, how many customers do they support and what revenue did those customers generate?
questions.sql: SELECT "e"."EmployeeId", CONCAT("e"."FirstName", ' ', "e"."LastName") AS "agent", COUNT(DISTINCT "c"."CustomerId") AS "customers_supported", COALESCE(SUM("i"."Total"), 0) AS "revenue" FROM "Employee" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "Customer" AS "c" ON "c"."SupportRepId" = "e"."EmployeeId" LEFT JOIN "Invoice" AS "i" ON "i"."CustomerId" = "c"."CustomerId" WHERE "e"."Title" = 'Sales Support Agent' GROUP BY "e"."EmployeeId", "e"."FirstName", "e"."LastName" ORDER BY agent ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: How many tracks does each genre have?
questions.sql: SELECT "g"."Name" AS "genre", COUNT("t"."TrackId") AS "track_count" FROM "Genre" AS "g" LEFT JOIN "Track" AS "t" ON "t"."GenreId" = "g"."GenreId" GROUP BY "g"."GenreId", "g"."Name" ORDER BY "g"."Name" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: List the tracks of the album "Let There Be Rock"
questions.sql: SELECT "Track"."Name" FROM "Track" INNER JOIN "Album" ON "Track"."AlbumId" = "Album"."AlbumId" WHERE "Album"."Title" = 'Let There Be Rock' ORDER BY "Track"."Name" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Which customers has Steve Johnson been assigned?
questions.sql: SELECT CONCAT("c"."FirstName", ' ', "c"."LastName") AS "customer" FROM "Customer" AS "c" INNER JOIN "Employee" AS "e" ON "e"."EmployeeId" = "c"."SupportRepId" WHERE "e"."FirstName" = 'Steve' AND "e"."LastName" = 'Johnson' ORDER BY customer ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Revenue per album, top 20
questions.sql: SELECT "Album"."Title", SUM("InvoiceLine"."UnitPrice" * "InvoiceLine"."Quantity") AS "line_revenue" FROM "InvoiceLine" LEFT JOIN "Track" ON "Track"."TrackId" = "InvoiceLine"."TrackId" LEFT JOIN "Album" ON "Album"."AlbumId" = "Track"."AlbumId" GROUP BY "Album"."Title" ORDER BY "line_revenue" DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: How much revenue did the genre named exactly "Rock" generate?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM("InvoiceLine"."UnitPrice" * "InvoiceLine"."Quantity") AS "line_revenue" FROM "InvoiceLine" LEFT JOIN "Track" ON "Track"."TrackId" = "InvoiceLine"."TrackId" LEFT JOIN "Genre" ON "Genre"."GenreId" = "Track"."GenreId" WHERE "Genre"."Name" = 'Rock' LIMIT 501

questions.question: How many distinct tracks has each customer bought?
questions.sql: SELECT "c"."CustomerId", "c"."FirstName" || ' ' || "c"."LastName" AS "CustomerName", COUNT(DISTINCT "il"."TrackId") AS "DistinctTracksBought" FROM "Customer" AS "c" INNER JOIN "Invoice" AS "i" ON "i"."CustomerId" = "c"."CustomerId" INNER JOIN "InvoiceLine" AS "il" ON "il"."InvoiceId" = "i"."InvoiceId" GROUP BY "c"."CustomerId", "c"."FirstName", "c"."LastName" ORDER BY "CustomerName" ASC, "c"."CustomerId" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Customers who never placed an order
questions.sql: SELECT "c"."CustomerId", CONCAT("c"."FirstName", ' ', "c"."LastName") AS "customer" FROM "Customer" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "Invoice" AS "i" ON "i"."CustomerId" = "c"."CustomerId" WHERE "i"."InvoiceId" IS NULL ORDER BY customer ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Albums that have no tracks
questions.sql: SELECT "Album"."AlbumId", "Album"."Title" FROM "Album" LEFT JOIN "Track" ON "Track"."AlbumId" = "Album"."AlbumId" WHERE "Track"."TrackId" IS NULL ORDER BY "Album"."Title" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: How many tracks did Iron Maiden record?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Track"."TrackId") AS "track_count" FROM "Track" INNER JOIN "Album" ON "Track"."AlbumId" = "Album"."AlbumId" INNER JOIN "Artist" ON "Album"."ArtistId" = "Artist"."ArtistId" WHERE "Artist"."Name" ILIKE 'Iron Maiden' LIMIT 501

questions.question: For each manager, how many people report to them directly?
questions.sql: SELECT "manager"."FirstName" || ' ' || "manager"."LastName" AS "manager_name", COUNT("employee"."EmployeeId") AS "direct_reports" FROM "Employee" AS "manager" LEFT JOIN "Employee" AS "employee" ON "employee"."ReportsTo" = "manager"."EmployeeId" GROUP BY "manager"."EmployeeId", "manager"."FirstName", "manager"."LastName" ORDER BY manager_name ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Which artists appear on the playlist "Grunge"?
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT "ar"."ArtistId", "ar"."Name" AS "artist" FROM "Playlist" AS "p" INNER JOIN "PlaylistTrack" AS "pt" ON "pt"."PlaylistId" = "p"."PlaylistId" INNER JOIN "Track" AS "t" ON "t"."TrackId" = "pt"."TrackId" INNER JOIN "Album" AS "al" ON "al"."AlbumId" = "t"."AlbumId" INNER JOIN "Artist" AS "ar" ON "ar"."ArtistId" = "al"."ArtistId" WHERE "p"."Name" = 'Grunge' ORDER BY artist ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Revenue per sales agent per year
questions.sql: SELECT CONCAT("e"."FirstName", ' ', "e"."LastName") AS "sales_agent", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "i"."InvoiceDate") AS "year", SUM("i"."Total") AS "revenue" FROM "Invoice" AS "i" INNER JOIN "Customer" AS "c" ON "c"."CustomerId" = "i"."CustomerId" INNER JOIN "Employee" AS "e" ON "e"."EmployeeId" = "c"."SupportRepId" WHERE "e"."Title" = 'Sales Support Agent' GROUP BY "e"."EmployeeId", "e"."FirstName", "e"."LastName", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "i"."InvoiceDate") ORDER BY year ASC, sales_agent ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Which genre is the most popular in each country?
Tracks that are on more than three playlists
questions.sql: SELECT "Track"."TrackId", "Track"."Name", COUNT(DISTINCT "PlaylistTrack"."PlaylistId") AS "playlist_count" FROM "Track" INNER JOIN "PlaylistTrack" ON "Track"."TrackId" = "PlaylistTrack"."TrackId" GROUP BY "Track"."TrackId", "Track"."Name" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "PlaylistTrack"."PlaylistId") > 3 ORDER BY "playlist_count" DESC, "Track"."Name" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Adding up the catalog price of the track on every invoice line, one price per line sold, what is the total?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM("t"."UnitPrice") AS "total_catalog_price" FROM "InvoiceLine" AS "il" INNER JOIN "Track" AS "t" ON "t"."TrackId" = "il"."TrackId" LIMIT 501

questions.question: What is the average length in milliseconds of the tracks sold, counting a track once for each invoice line it appears on?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG("t"."Milliseconds") AS "average_length_milliseconds" FROM "InvoiceLine" AS "il" INNER JOIN "Track" AS "t" ON "t"."TrackId" = "il"."TrackId" LIMIT 501

questions.question: How many units were sold per playlist? Show the playlist name and the units.
questions.sql: SELECT "p"."PlaylistId", "p"."Name" AS "playlist", COALESCE(SUM("il"."Quantity"), 0) AS "units" FROM "Playlist" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "PlaylistTrack" AS "pt" ON "pt"."PlaylistId" = "p"."PlaylistId" LEFT JOIN "InvoiceLine" AS "il" ON "il"."TrackId" = "pt"."TrackId" GROUP BY "p"."PlaylistId", "p"."Name" ORDER BY "p"."Name" ASC, "p"."PlaylistId" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Show invoices from 2025
questions.sql: SELECT "InvoiceId", "InvoiceDate", "CustomerId", "BillingCountry", "Total" FROM "Invoice" WHERE "InvoiceDate" >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND "InvoiceDate" < DATE '2026-01-01' ORDER BY "InvoiceDate" ASC, "InvoiceId" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Invoices issued in March 2023
questions.sql: SELECT "Invoice"."InvoiceId", "Invoice"."CustomerId", "Invoice"."InvoiceDate", "Invoice"."BillingCountry", "Invoice"."Total" FROM "Invoice" WHERE "Invoice"."InvoiceDate" >= DATE '2023-03-01' AND "Invoice"."InvoiceDate" < DATE '2023-04-01' ORDER BY "Invoice"."InvoiceDate" ASC, "Invoice"."InvoiceId" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: How much did we sell last year?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM("Invoice"."Total") AS "revenue" FROM "Invoice" WHERE "Invoice"."InvoiceDate" >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND "Invoice"."InvoiceDate" < DATE '2026-01-01' LIMIT 501

questions.question: Invoices between June and August 2024
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "invoice_count", SUM("Total") AS "total_invoiced" FROM "Invoice" WHERE "InvoiceDate" >= '2024-06-01' AND "InvoiceDate" < '2024-09-01' LIMIT 501

questions.question: Revenue in the fourth quarter of 2022
questions.sql: SELECT SUM("Invoice"."Total") AS "revenue" FROM "Invoice" WHERE "Invoice"."InvoiceDate" >= '2022-10-01' AND "Invoice"."InvoiceDate" < '2023-01-01' LIMIT 501

questions.question: Which customers bought in 2021 but not in 2022?
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT "c"."CustomerId", CONCAT("c"."FirstName", ' ', "c"."LastName") AS "customer" FROM "Customer" AS "c" INNER JOIN "Invoice" AS "i" ON "i"."CustomerId" = "c"."CustomerId" WHERE "i"."InvoiceDate" >= DATE '2021-01-01' AND "i"."InvoiceDate" < DATE '2022-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Invoice" AS "i2" WHERE "i2"."CustomerId" = "c"."CustomerId" AND "i2"."InvoiceDate" >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND "i2"."InvoiceDate" < DATE '2023-01-01') ORDER BY customer ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Employees hired before 2003
questions.sql: SELECT "FirstName" || ' ' || "LastName" AS "FullName", "Title", "HireDate" FROM "Employee" WHERE "HireDate" < DATE '2003-01-01' ORDER BY "HireDate" ASC, "LastName" ASC, "FirstName" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: What was the first purchase date of each customer?
questions.sql: SELECT "Customer"."CustomerId", "Customer"."FirstName" || ' ' || "Customer"."LastName" AS "CustomerName", MIN("Invoice"."InvoiceDate") AS "FirstPurchaseDate" FROM "Customer" INNER JOIN "Invoice" ON "Invoice"."CustomerId" = "Customer"."CustomerId" GROUP BY "Customer"."CustomerId", "Customer"."FirstName", "Customer"."LastName" ORDER BY "CustomerName" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Invoices issued on weekends in 2024
questions.sql: SELECT "InvoiceId", "CustomerId", "InvoiceDate", "Total" FROM "Invoice" WHERE "InvoiceDate" >= '2024-01-01' AND "InvoiceDate" < '2025-01-01' AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM "InvoiceDate") IN (6, 7) ORDER BY "InvoiceDate" ASC, "InvoiceId" ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Compare revenue of 2024 with 2025
questions.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate") AS "period_year", SUM("Invoice"."Total") AS "revenue" FROM "Invoice" WHERE "Invoice"."InvoiceDate" >= '2024-01-01' AND "Invoice"."InvoiceDate" <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate") ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate") ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: How many invoices were issued in the first half of 2024?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT("InvoiceId") AS "invoice_count" FROM "Invoice" WHERE "InvoiceDate" >= '2024-01-01' AND "InvoiceDate" < '2024-07-01' LIMIT 501

questions.question: Revenue in December 2024

questions.question: Which month of 2023 had the highest revenue?
questions.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate") AS "period_year", EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate") AS "period_month", SUM("Invoice"."Total") AS "revenue" FROM "Invoice" WHERE "Invoice"."InvoiceDate" >= '2023-01-01' AND "Invoice"."InvoiceDate" < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate"), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "Invoice"."InvoiceDate") ORDER BY "revenue" DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Year over year revenue growth
questions.sql: WITH "yearly" AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "InvoiceDate") AS "yr", SUM("Total") AS "revenue" FROM "Invoice" GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "InvoiceDate")) SELECT yr, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY yr ASC) AS "prior_year_revenue", revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY yr ASC) AS "revenue_growth", CASE WHEN LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY yr ASC) IS NOT NULL AND LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY yr ASC) <> 0 THEN 100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY yr ASC)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY yr ASC) END AS "growth_percent" FROM "yearly" ORDER BY yr ASC LIMIT 501

questions.question: Using a WITH clause that joins invoices to their lines for tracks of the genre named exactly "Rock", what is the sum of the invoice totals of those invoices?
questions.sql: WITH "RockInvoices" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "i"."InvoiceId", "i"."Total" FROM "Invoice" AS "i" INNER JOIN "InvoiceLine" AS "il" ON "il"."InvoiceId" = "i"."InvoiceId" INNER JOIN "Track" AS "t" ON "t"."TrackId" = "il"."TrackId" INNER JOIN "Genre" AS "g" ON "g"."GenreId" = "t"."GenreId" WHERE "g"."Name" = 'Rock') SELECT SUM("RockInvoices"."Total") AS "sum_invoice_totals" FROM "RockInvoices" LIMIT 501
